text:
adele_se: Quick request from Ember procurement 1 they want a compact SIEM/audit packet for vendor review: sample admin events, detection examples, forwarding options (Splunk HEC/syslog/S3), retention numbers, and whether we support customer KMS + immutability. POC starts Thursday.

marco_sec: I'll assemble. Map notes: admin/audit -> CAIQ/CCM audit controls; forwarding/monitoring -> SIG.MON; retention/immutability -> SIG.RET.

adele_se: Can you paste two single-line JSON examples and a tiny forwarder snippet I can paste into the questionnaire?

marco_sec: Admin action (single-line): {"event_type":"admin_action","ts":"2025-12-20T10:02:00Z","actor":"u_214","action":"revoke_key","target":"api_key_77","req":"r_7001"} 

marco_sec: Detection example (single-line): {"event_type":"detection","ts":"2025-12-20T10:05:12Z","name":"admin_login_spike","sev":"high","count":34} 

zara_ops: Minimal Splunk HEC forwarder (curl): curl -s https://splunk.ember.local:8088/services/collector -H "Authorization: Splunk <token>" -d @/var/log/redwood/audit.log

marco_sec: Retention defaults (Hosted): API logs 90d hot / 13mo cold; Admin/audit 1 year default; Auth events 13 months; Inference metrics 90 days. Optional archival up to 7 years to customer S3 (gzipped ndjson) with Object Lock for immutability. POC: we can keep 6 months on request.

marco_sec: Short encryption + access line to paste: "All logs encrypted in transit (TLS1.2+) and at rest (AES-256). Customers may provide a KMS key for S3 archival. Audit access is role-based (SOC/org_admin) and access is itself logged."

adele_se: Good. Also add a one-liner about network controls: we can provide egress IP ranges and support mutual TLS for HEC endpoints on request.

zara_ops: Noted. We'll include example egress IPs in the appendix and show rsyslog snippet for syslog customers if they prefer push.

proof-bot: Exported sample bundle to /shared/sales/ember/siem-packet at 2025-12-20T11:00:00Z.

adele_se: I'll send to Ember procurement with the one-pager and attach these snippets. Tagging legal if they ask for an immutable retention SLA.

marco_sec: If they ask for formal CAIQ evidence we can attach the mapping doc and SOC contact (marco_sec@redwood.ai).

adele_se: Sent to buyer at 2025-12-20T11:12Z. Marking thread resolved unless they request network allowlist or legal retention terms.
